title: Reopen the frozen E and F draft PRs once the bg-tail D and B chain lands
why: The owner chose to close the frozen E and F PRs of lane bg-tail-loses-verdict for now and reopen them later; nobody acts on a reopen unless a step holds it.
note: Owner chat 13:02 CST Nov 10, pick a, via coordinator 13:10 CST; corrected by coordinator 13:26 CST (from the bg-tail lane 13:25 CST). E and F were closed so the lane lint's cross check can pass for D and B; reopening them early would block D and B again. The mixed-merge route is already on main (decision builders-cannot-edit-tests, merge route, owner item 420 a). When the D and B chain of step bg-tail-loses-verdict is on main: reopen #2113 #2208 #2241 #2291 #2105 #2165 #2227 #2269 (heads kept at archive/other-checkout-read, archive/other-checkout-wrapper-env, archive/wrapper-flag-values, archive/wrapper-runner-list, archive/frozen-python-writes, archive/frozen-python-gaps, archive/frozen-scan-crash-closes, archive/frozen-crash-residuals), merge main, hand them to a lane.
